Its divide figures are the best available: 53.9 internet users per 100 (ITU 2021), 7.8 unique mobile broadband subscriptions per 100 - lowest in West and Central Africa - and electricity access 91 per cent urban against 0.9 per cent rural (2020), with the explicit finding that no sufficiently disaggregated official data exists to quantify the island-mainland gap.
